name: Field-margin hedges and buffer strips

soft_risks.risk: Margins take a strip of land out of production
soft_risks.mitigation: Site strips on the least productive edges and field boundaries already out of use

soft_risks.risk: Woody margins may not be permitted on leased land
soft_risks.mitigation: Use herbaceous flower strips rather than woody hedges

mechanism: Permanent vegetation at field edges supplies flowering resources and nesting habitat, and reconnects patches across an otherwise uniform field.
